subject: Renewal: Annual AppSec Testing & SOW (PenTestCo) — timing and budget
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@pentestco.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 02 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal: Annual AppSec Testing & SOW (PenTestCo) — timing and budget

Hi Sophie,

Hope you had a great week. Our annual pen test / appsec engagement is up in June and wed like to lock in scope, timing, and cost for this year. Last year's red team + app stack review was valuable; Mina and I want to confirm essentially the same scope (external blackbox, authenticated appflow + API assessment, quick cloud infra review).

A few asks from our side:
- Target window: June 15 - July 2 (we need a final report and executive summary by July 9)
- Same attack surface as 2025: public endpoints, customer-facing API, web console (authenticated), and CI/CD pipeline touchpoints (light)
- Deliverables: executive summary, detailed findings with reproduction steps, prioritized remediation matrix, and a 1-hr findings sync with engineering and product

Budget is constrained this cycle; can you provisionally confirm whether PenTestCo can hold last yeard pricing or provide a renewal discount for repeat scope? Also attach the SOW/quote and any kick-off checklist.

Mina will be the technical lead on our side and will own the logistics. Looping her in so she can share artifacts.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment: none in this message
From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@pentestco.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Matt Clancy <matt.clancy@pentestco.com>, PenTestCo Sales <sales@pentestco.com>
Date: Mon, 04 May 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: Annual AppSec Testing & SOW (PenTestCo) — timing and budget

Hi Karthik,

Great to hear from you — glad last year's engagement helped. I've attached an updated SOW (PenTestCo_SOW_v3.pdf) and a line-item quote (PTC-quote-May2026.xlsx). We can accommodate the June 15 start and commit to the July 9 delivery for the final report.

Summary of changes from 2025:
- Consolidated authenticated test hours to reduce redundancy (saves ~6 hours)
- Minor uptick for API schema fuzzing tooling (adds $1,200)
- Offered a 7% renewal discount given repeat engagement and early commitment

If we proceed on the quoted amount your total comes to $32,400 after discount. If finance needs more time, we can provisionally hold pricing for 14 days.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Review attached SOW and quote
2) Share any legal redlines and a PO (or we can route via DocuSign)
3) Kickoff prework: access window, test accounts, and scope confirmation meeting (30m)

Let me know when youd like to set the scope confirmation meeting; Im available Wed/Thu morning.

Best,
Sophie Turner
Engagement Lead, PenTestCo

Attachments: PenTestCo_SOW_v3.pdf (PDF, 220KB); PTC-quote-May2026.xlsx (XLSX, 34KB)
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@pentestco.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 05 May 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: Annual AppSec Testing & SOW (PenTestCo) — timing and budget

Thanks Sophie,

I scanned the SOW and the scope looks aligned. A couple of technical clarifications before we sign:
- For the authenticated console tests, can you confirm whether credentialed testing will be via test accounts or token-based API keys? We prefer short-lived test accounts if possible.
- Please confirm the exact list of API endpoints you will fuzz and whether third-party hosted endpoints (analytics.example.com) are excluded
- Can you add a clause allowing a 10-business-day remediation verification pass post-report (small fee listed in SOW)?

If those are acceptable, I can expedite a brief redline doc and get legal looped in.

Mina Haddad
Director, Security Engineering
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Renewal: Annual AppSec Testing & SOW (PenTestCo) — timing and budget

Sophie,

Thanks for the SOW. I reviewed the commercial terms quickly and legal has one major ask: the indemnity paragraph needs narrowing — we can't accept open-ended liability for third-party infra issues. I've attached a redline (Redlines_KI_20260504.docx) with suggested language for section 7 and a proposed 10-business-day verification clause as Mina requested.

Also: finance asked if PenTestCo can accept the Redwood standard procurement flow: PO + Net30 rather than DocuSign signature (we can still sign via DocuSign if you prefer). If you can confirm acceptance of Net30, that would speed approvals.

If the redline is acceptable, can you re-issue an SOW with the legal changes and the final quote? Wed like to get this fully executed by end of week to keep the June slot.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Renewal: Annual AppSec Testing & SOW (PenTestCo) — timing and budget

Dev, Karthik,

Thanks for the redlines — appreciate the quick turnaround. We reviewed internally and can accept the narrowed indemnity language with the 10-business-day verification clause added. We can also accept PO + Net30; our sales ops will route the invoice after DocuSign so you get an invoice referencing the PO number.

I've attached a revised SOW with your requested edits and updated quote (SOW v3.1). If that looks good I'll send a DocuSign envelope (or you can route a PO) — either path works.

Proposed immediate next steps:
- Karthik: confirm whether you want DocuSign or PO flow
- Mina: confirm final test-account cadence and provide an initial list of endpoints by Friday EOD
- Sophie/Matt: target kick-off call Mon, June 15 10:00am PT

We can hold the quoted price through May 20.

Best,
Sophie Turner
Engagement Lead, PenTestCo
